blog.ai-wedding-video-workflow.li_text.s: Step 1: Upload 30+ Photos: Drop your 30-50 wedding photos into our secure browser-side uploader. No app install, no account required. Files stay on your device unless you opt to share them with us.

Step 2: Pick a Style (12 Options): Choose from 12 wedding video styles: cinematic, documentary, traditional, storytelling, vintage, Ghibli anime, cartoon, meme, slow-motion, trailer, multilingual, or family tribute. Each style costs $9.9.

Step 3: AI Generates in 9 Minutes: Our AI processes your photos + style choice + optional music (11,000+ tracks available) and outputs a 60-90s finished video. Most styles complete in under 9 minutes.
Step 4: Preview + Optional Revision: Preview your video in-browser. If you'd like changes (music swap, caption edit, color tone), request a free revision with 24h turnaround.
Step 5: Download or Share: Download MP4 (1080p) or share via private link. Full commercial rights included. Files encrypted and deleted after 30 days unless you request longer retention.

blog.ai-wedding-video-workflow.p_text.cl: For complex multi-cam live events (full ceremony + reception with 2+ cameras, drone footage, livestream), traditional videography is still required. AI cannot capture in-the-moment audio or live reactions. Use AI for highlight reels, trailers, save-the-dates, family tributes, restoration, and multilingual edits.

Couples usually have 3-4 questions before they start. After 500+ orders, we've heard them all. Here are the most common, answered with the specific data behind each.

"What if I don't have 30 photos?" Use candid phone snaps, engagement photos, even AI-generated portraits. Quality matters more than quantity — 30 great photos beats 100 blurry ones.
"Can I add my own music?" Yes. Upload any royalty-free or licensed track. AI syncs cuts to the beat automatically.
"How private is this?" Photos never leave your browser for processing. AI generation runs browser-side. We delete your photos 30 days after delivery unless you opt in to long-term storage.
"What if I hate the result?" Two free revisions included. If still not satisfied, full refund within 7 days. 500+ couples served; refund rate is <2%.
